answers.reason: Concession dropped: ても makes the suffering conceded, not listed. Restored with 'even though' while keeping tiredness wording and plain husband register.

Stet: Japanese says 二年はもう過ぎた; は is topical, not 'at least'. Adding 'at least' would harmonise the three-years count the reading requires be kept distinct; the odd two-years wording must stand literal.

notes: Two-years vs three-years tension left visible for Analyst/editor; no silent harmonisation.
data.revised_english: "That's right. Even though day by day we are tired out and troubled and made to suffer by one thing and another, two years are already past. In a little while {t:boya} will be walking too."
data.say: Restored the husband's even-though concession and kept the literal two years.
